userRuleLiteral: one arc bubble is 1/6 plank length

arcBubble.interpretation: One-sixth of the Planck length per symbolic arc; not observed sub-Planck geometry

illustrativeRing.chosenRepresentation: six equal circular arcs placed end-to-end; diagram convention only
illustrativeRing.warning: Treating one Planck length as a ring circumference is an optional graphical convention; one-sixth length alone does not imply a radius, circle, or physical toroidal boundary.

classification: This is a symbolic mathematical subdivision of a length, not detection or engineering of a sub-Planck arc.
Planck length is not experimentally established as the shortest divisible length.
The Planck time is retained separately; specifying arc length does not assign elapsed time to that arc.
The six-arc ring is one optional drawing choice and does not assert circular geometry in the underlying physics.
No previous baseline, including v7.8, is modified.
